description:
Compact oversized files: TASKS.jsonl, docs/API.md, backend/api/websocket.go — These files have grown large and hurt context-window efficiency for Ralph.

TASKS.jsonl (200 lines, 196 done): Remove all entries with status=done. Keep only todo, in_progress, and blocked tasks. This is safe because completed task history is preserved in git.

docs/API.md (1204 lines): Deduplicate content that is already documented in specs/auth.md and specs/interaction-logging.md. API.md should have concise endpoint reference tables (method, path, auth required, rate limit, brief description) with links to the relevant spec files for full request/response details. Remove inline request/response JSON examples that duplicate the specs.

backend/api/websocket.go (979 lines): Split into multiple files by responsibility. Suggested split: websocket.go (connection setup, ServeHTTP, message routing), websocket_audio.go (processAudio, transcribeAudio, audio blob saving), websocket_llm.go (processTranscript, LLM tool execution, buffer trimming), websocket_tts.go (TTS execution, greeting). Each file should be under 500 lines. Keep all functions in the same api package.
done_when: 1) TASKS.jsonl contains only non-done tasks (todo/in_progress/blocked) 2) docs/API.md under 500 lines with endpoint summary tables linking to specs for details 3) backend/api/websocket.go split into 3-4 files, each under 500 lines 4) go test ./... passes 5) No functionality changes — pure compaction/reorganization
